test_navigate_to_online_site.title: Verify clicking a site card navigates into the site detail view

steps.expected: The site cards are listed and at least one shows the online marker.

steps.action: Click an online site's card.
steps.expected: The site detail opens with its Groups line, and the site list with its Version lines is gone.

test_camera_sorting.title: Verify A-Z and Z-A camera sorting within a site

steps.action: Open Admin > Sites and open an online site.
steps.expected: The site detail lists its cameras.

steps.action: Click the A-Z sort icon, then the Z-A sort icon.
steps.expected: The camera order reverses between the two sorts when the site has more than one camera.

test_delete_camera_group.title: Verify deleting a camera group with Yes confirmation.

steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Admin > Sites
steps.expected: Sites page loads without errors

steps.action: Identify the deleting a camera group to be deleted from the list
steps.expected: deleting a camera group is visible and identifiable in the list

steps.action: Note the current count of items in the list
steps.expected: Current item count is recorded for later comparison

steps.action: Click the delete button or action for the target deleting a camera group
steps.expected: A confirmation dialog or prompt appears

steps.action: Verify the confirmation dialog displays the correct item being deleted
steps.expected: Dialog shows the name or identifier of the deleting a camera group

steps.action: Click Confirm/Yes/Delete to proceed with the deletion
steps.expected: Deletion is processed and a success message appears

steps.action: Verify the deleting a camera group no longer appears in the list
steps.expected: deleting a camera group is removed from the list view

steps.action: Verify the item count decreased by one
steps.expected: List count reflects the removal

steps.action: Set up precondition: with Yes confirmation
steps.expected: Precondition is met (with Yes confirmation)

steps.action: Refresh the page and confirm the deletion persisted
steps.expected: The deleted deleting a camera group does not reappear after refresh
